footer.shortDescription: This project presents a technical demonstration of an automated pipeline flow for serverless architecture on AWS. Using Terraform and GitHub Actions, it exemplifies a scalable, secure, and cost-effective continuous delivery model.

home.title: Welcome to the Pipeline Demo!
home.subtitle: Infrastructure as Code & Automation
home.description: This is a technical presentation focused on the deploy flow and pipeline of a serverless architecture on AWS.

seeMore.title: Presentation: AWS Delivery Pipeline
seeMore.description:
This project demonstrates the inner workings of a Cloud-Native pipeline for deploying static web applications. The primary focus is the orchestration between Next.js (in static export mode) and AWS serverless infrastructure.

The solution highlights how Terraform (IaC) provisions resources such as S3, CloudFront (CDN), and Origin Access Control (OAC) in a standardized way. The core differentiator is the CI/CD pipeline managed by GitHub Actions: with every code update, the workflow automates provisioning, performs the build, synchronizes assets, and invalidates the global cache. The result is a modern workflow that prioritizes delivery speed, security, and high scalability without the need for manual intervention.

about.title: About the Workflow
about.description: This project was developed as a technical showcase for Architecture and Automation. It utilizes Terraform to ensure that Edge Computing infrastructure on AWS is replicable and resilient, connecting software development directly to cloud operations through a robust CI/CD pipeline.

resource.title:
Continuous Delivery Flow
for Static Sites
resource.description: Optimize the software lifecycle with end-to-end automation. This pipeline is designed to transform source code into a globally available product on AWS. The process uses GitHub Actions as the main orchestrator, integrating the frontend build with infrastructure provisioning via Terraform. This approach ensures consistency across environments, credential security, and a clear audit trail for every change made to the system.
resource.subtitle: Architectures & Implementations
resource.descriptionResources:
This section presents a portfolio of architectures focused on Cloud Solutions and Automation.

Each module uses Terraform as the gold standard for Infrastructure as Code (IaC), demonstrating versatility across different technical scenarios.
You will find everything from pipelines for high-performance serverless solutions to robust architectures with VPCs, container clusters (ECS), and Application Load Balancing (ALB).

These implementations serve as proof-of-concept for application modernization strategies, focusing on resilient design, complex deploy automation, and resource optimization on AWS.

resourcesList.title: Automation with Terraform & Packer
resourcesList.description: This lab focuses on image automation and scalable infrastructure. It uses Terraform and Packer to create custom AMIs and manage dev and prod environments with auto-scaling, validating complex mutable and immutable infrastructure flows.

resourcesList.title: CI/CD Standardization
resourcesList.description: A solution dedicated to state management and infrastructure governance. It demonstrates how to structure GitHub Actions pipelines to validate and apply Terraform plans with security and agility.

resourcesList.title: Fullstack Serverless Development
resourcesList.description: Case study focused on development agility using AWS Amplify. Integrates services like Lambda, DynamoDB, and Bedrock (AI), demonstrating a fast delivery flow for apps requiring AI and secure authentication.

resourcesList.title: Container Orchestration
resourcesList.description: Presentation of microservices-based architecture. Uses ECS Fargate to run containers without managing servers, integrating ECR for image management and ALBs for intelligent traffic distribution.

iac_infra.title: Standardization with IaC
iac_infra.description: Using Terraform allows all infrastructure to be versionable and reproducible, eliminating manual configurations and reducing operational errors.

solucoes_modernas.title: Serverless Focus
solucoes_modernas.description: Adopting technologies like S3, CloudFront, and Lambda to create solutions that scale from zero to infinity with cost proportional to usage.

automacao_devops.title: DevOps Culture
automacao_devops.description: Implementation of CI/CD Pipelines that automate tests, builds, and deploys, promoting a continuous and secure delivery environment.

infra.title: Architecture Design
infra.description: Infrastructure is defined via code. Explore the components below to understand the data flow and service layers.

browser.title: User Access
browser.description: The flow starts at the client, where the request is routed via DNS to the AWS global network, searching for the nearest edge location.

cdn.title: Global Distribution (CDN)
cdn.description: CloudFront manages the cache of static files globally. This ensures content is delivered with minimal latency and protects the origin against overload.

oac.title: Origin Security (OAC)
oac.description: Origin Access Control restricts S3 bucket access. Only authorized CloudFront distributions can read files, keeping the infrastructure private and secure.

s3.title: Asset Storage
s3.description: Amazon S3 acts as the durable repository for the Next.js build. It is a highly available and cost-optimized object storage solution.

github.title: Deploy Orchestration
github.description: GitHub Actions integrates all parts, triggering the deploy lifecycle whenever a new improvement is detected in the source code.

ci.title: CI/CD Pipeline
ci.description: Automation ensures system integrity. Learn the stages of the continuous delivery pipeline.

repository.title: 1. Version Trigger
repository.description: Every confirmed change in GitHub starts the process. The system validates changes and prepares the environment for automation tools.

build.title: 2. Artifact Generation
build.description: The application is compiled and exported as a static site. This process transforms dynamic components into high-performance assets.

terraform.title: 3. Infra Sync (Terraform)
terraform.description: Terraform checks if the AWS infrastructure matches the code. If discrepancies exist, it applies corrections automatically.

s3.title: 4. Content Deploy
s3.description: New files are synced to S3. The process is intelligent: only modified files are transferred, saving time and bandwidth.

cdn.title: 5. Cache Update
cdn.description: To make changes instantaneous for the end user, the pipeline requests a CDN cache invalidation, ensuring the latest version is served.

advantages.title: Automated Model Advantages
advantages.description: A strategy focused on pipeline and serverless brings direct benefits to the project's operation.

cost.title: Cost Efficiency
cost.description: Pay strictly for what is consumed, without idle costs from servers running 24/7.

availability.title: Native Scalability
availability.description: The infrastructure supports anywhere from a few users to millions of hits automatically and resiliently.

security.title: Secure Pipeline
security.description: Automated processes reduce human error and ensure security policies are applied in every deploy.
